notes.title: Disturbed Beyond Aramor 2.8 Build Update | Bug Fix
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28424444/d8fa13f9f45209dd82d3cecae11f37e1760c6e9e.png[/img]
Updated the game engine after a few years now. Due to this, a number of bugs are fixed. Fingers crossed this also fixed a lot of the crashing that was taking place. After some playtesting, the errors I replicated have been resolved. If there are more issues, please let me know and I'll see what I can do.

I've been inactive the past few years. The year 2024 will bring something new.

I just want to thank those who have taken the time to report bugs and suggest improvements. I also appreciate the kind feedback that I have received over the past few weeks.

For those who haven't, I encourage you to leave a review for the game and/or feedback in the discussion board. It really helps me as a developer know where I succeeded and failed.

Thank you for your support. :dba_Sacred:

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
I just wanted to make a post since I've been pretty silent for these past couple months. The game is still in development, but due to distractions and school, it will be likely that the game will reach completion around late-summer.

In a lot of ways, this project has stretched me creatively, which came with some things not working as planned. A lot of story refinements have been made along with alterations of the script. This was done in part to help balance the game. Originally I wanted a lot of RNG involved, but I realize that for this visual novel/adventure hybrid, it probably would prove frustrating to a lot of people. So, a lot has been changed from the original drafts. Hopefully, with these things worked out soon, I'll be posting more visual updates. I have a goal to post another video in the near future that will display some of the combat, if not, a more refined representation of the game.

Anyhow, I thought I'd make an announcement. The game is being developed, just slower than planned. Thanks. ːwarhorseː
